description: GCR proton omnidirectional flux spectra at various heliocentric distances and solar modulation states. Units: protons/cm²/s (group-integrated over each energy bin).

gcr_1au_avg.description: GCR at 1 AU, averaged solar modulation (between solar min and max)

gcr_1au_min.description: GCR at 1 AU, solar minimum (maximum GCR intensity, 1.4x average)

gcr_1au_max.description: GCR at 1 AU, solar maximum (minimum GCR intensity, 0.6x average)

gcr_1_5au.description: GCR at 1.5 AU (Mars orbit), averaged solar modulation (1.15x 1AU average)

spe_event.description: Solar Particle Event integrated fluence (single impulsive event). Units: protons/cm² (total fluence, not rate). Much softer spectrum than GCR.
